title: WangchanThaiInstruct: An instruction-following Dataset for Culture-Aware, Multitask, and Multi-domain Evaluation in Thai
reasoning: The paper focuses on evaluating large language models on their cultural and professional grounding within specific domains such as legal, medical, financial, and retail contexts in the Thai language. It does not include a specific evaluation or benchmarking component for religion, faith, spiritual traditions, morals, or ethics.
